# Shebercraft — Autonomous AI Agents & Custom Web Engineering

> Shebercraft (https://shebercraft.kz/en/) is a specialized engineering agency that designs, builds, and deploys custom 24/7 autonomous AI agents, conversion-engineered B2B web applications, and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) for clients in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and globally.

## Core Capabilities & Services

### 1. Autonomous AI Agents & 24/7 Concierge
- **URL**: https://shebercraft.kz/en/#ai-agents
- **Fixed Price**: $2,490 (One-time delivery)
- **Turnaround**: 10–14 business days
- **Tech Stack**: OpenAI GPT-4o, Anthropic Claude 3.5 Sonnet, LangChain, Pinecone vector stores, Python FastAPI.
- **Description**: Intelligent AI employee that answers complex buyer inquiries directly from your private company documentation (whitepapers, pricing sheets, FAQs) with zero hallucinations.
- **Key Features**:
  - Autonomous lead qualification using BANT scoring criteria.
  - Native calendar booking via Calendly or Google Calendar.
  - Live bi-directional synchronization with HubSpot, Salesforce, GoHighLevel, and Slack.
  - Multi-channel deployment: Interactive web widget and two-way SMS / Twilio.
  - 45 days of continuous prompt tuning and vector optimization included.

### 2. High-Performance B2B Web & SaaS Development
- **URL**: https://shebercraft.kz/en/#services
- **Pricing**:
  - *Sprint Landing Page*: $1,490 (7 business days turnaround)
  - *Corporate Web Application*: $4,900 (14–21 business days turnaround)
- **Tech Stack**: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, PostgreSQL.
- **Performance**: Sub-second edge CDN loading (< 0.8s), 99+ Core Web Vitals, mobile-first responsive architecture.
- **Features**: Bespoke Figma UI/UX, conversion copywriting, technical SEO, open graph metadata, Headless CMS integration, and form webhooks.

### 3. Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) & Technical SEO
- **URL**: https://shebercraft.kz/en/#geo-hub
- **Pricing**: Retainers from $1,200 / month
- **Description**: Next-generation search authority engineered to get your brand cited, synthesized, and recommended inside leading artificial intelligence engines (Perplexity, ChatGPT Search, Claude, Google AI Overviews) as well as traditional Google search.
- **Deliverables**: Entity graph schema markup, semantic keyword clustering, technical site speed audits, and authoritative knowledge base architecture.

## Enterprise Guarantees & Terms
- **100% IP Ownership**: All source code, designs, and vector database schemas transfer fully to the client upon final milestone payment.
- **Zero Vendor Lock-in**: Clean, documented code that can be deployed to AWS, Vercel, Supabase, or private infrastructure.
- **Data Privacy & Compliance**: Client documentation is never used to train public foundation models.
- **Collaboration Model**: Dedicated Slack/Teams channel with daily async updates and extensive overlap with US Eastern and Pacific business hours.
